title: BM25, explained through this site's search box
description: How BM25 scores a document, term by term: saturation with k1, length normalisation with b, a never-negative IDF, and a worked example by hand.

title: Drawing benzene's π orbitals from Hückel theory
description: How the benzene figure on the homepage is made: Hückel π orbitals, Slater 2p functions, and points sampled from the probability density, coloured by sign.

title: Reading an MD trajectory: radial distribution function and mean squared displacement
description: How to compute g(r) and the mean squared displacement from a periodic MD trajectory, with a short numpy implementation tested on cases with known answers.

title: Molecule3D: a LAMMPS workbench that runs in your browser
description: What Molecule3D (LAMMPS Web GUI) does, who it is for, and what a first session looks like, from a starter script to a trajectory and its RDF.

title: Sycophancy in LLMs, and why we test it on court cases
description: What sycophancy in language models is, why legal reasoning exposes it sharply, and how the SycoLex benchmark measures it with paired, opposite prompts.

title: Kohn–Sham DFT on one page
description: The chain of ideas behind a DFT calculation, from Born–Oppenheimer and the Hohenberg–Kohn theorems to the Kohn–Sham equations, functionals and basis sets.

title: AgriIR, a configurable RAG pipeline for agricultural questions
description: How AgriIR answers agricultural questions with small open models in six configurable stages, attaches citations deterministically, and how it was evaluated.

title: Hybrid search with BM25, dense embeddings and reciprocal rank fusion
description: Why a RAG system should run keyword and embedding search side by side, and how reciprocal rank fusion merges them without calibrating scores.

title: Computational Chemistry in the Age of AI: From DFT to Neural Potentials
description: A comprehensive look at how Machine Learning is revolutionizing computational chemistry, bridging the gap between quantum accuracy and classical speed.

title: Building a RAG system: lessons from a campus intranet
description: Lessons from a retrieval-augmented generation system for the IISER Kolkata intranet: the data pipeline, hybrid dense and BM25 search, chunking, cited answers.

title: Building Scalable Web Apps with Modern Stacks
description: A guide to modern web architecture, focusing on performance, scalability, and the shift towards edge computing and serverless patterns.

title: The Future of Computational Chemistry: AI & Quantum Computing
description: Exploring how Artificial Intelligence and Quantum Computing are revolutionizing the field of computational chemistry, from drug discovery to materials science.

title: Large Language Models: A Deep Dive into Architecture and Capabilities
description: An in-depth exploration of Transformer architecture, Attention mechanisms, and the evolution of LLMs from GPT-1 to GPT-4 and beyond.

title: Tip-of-the-tongue search at TREC 2024, with BM25 and rewritten queries
description: How our TREC 2024 Tip-of-the-Tongue runs rewrote vague queries with an LLM in four phases and used layered BM25 retrieval to reach Recall@1000 of 0.8067.

title: Understanding DFT methods in catalyst design
description: How density functional theory is used to design catalysts: the workflow, choosing a functional and basis set, the main pitfalls, and where the field is going.

title: Python libraries for computational chemistry
description: The Python libraries computational chemists use most (RDKit, ASE, PySCF, MDAnalysis, py3Dmol), what each is for, and a worked example joining them.
